title: RustConf 2020 - Closing Keynote by Siân Griffin
summary: RustConf 2020 closing keynote by Sian Griffin that dives into Pokemon Blue glitches, notably Missingno and arbitrary-code-execution tricks. It uses them to explain how memory unsafety works and how memory-safe languages like Rust prevent such bugs.
why: HN points to it as a fun, technically deep talk that makes memory-safety bugs vivid through a beloved game.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I really enjoyed the RustConf 2020 Closing Keynote
